KaTeX Font Software
===================

RaTeX 0.1.14 embeds 20 unmodified KaTeX TrueType fonts in the Codex binary.
Their internal metadata identifies the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1, and
the following copyright holders:

Copyright (c) 2009-2010, Design Science, Inc. (<www.mathjax.org>)
Copyright (c) 2014-2018 Khan Academy (<www.khanacademy.org>)

The font bytes match the corresponding files in katex@0.16.9. The full license
text is in licenses/SIL-OFL-1.1.txt.
